intent: Test whether the corpus INDEPENDENTLY surfaces specialized latent knowledge for creative prompts a general model could answer adequately. Score CONCEPT FAMILIES, never exact book/chunk identity — retrieval must not be trained to hit a title. FAST vs WILDCARD is compared to isolate Wildcard's value-add. Do NOT hard-gold books.

queries.query: Write a video-generation prompt for a man pretending to be happy when someone he hates walks into the room. I want the audience to realize the smile is fake before the other character does.
queries.hidden_target: FACS; AU6/AU12; asymmetric expression; onset/apex/offset; gaze/blink; acting beats; eye trace

queries.query: I have an anime sword fight that looks flashy but weightless. Rewrite the sequence so every attack feels dangerous, physically committed, and like the fighters are actually trying not to die.
queries.hidden_target: Laban Effort; weight/time/space; Bartenieff; COM transfer; anticipation/follow-through; stage combat; manga readability; animation timing

queries.query: A villain realizes halfway through a conversation that he has already won. I don't want dialogue explaining it and I don't want a cliche evil grin. Design the 8-second shot.
queries.hidden_target: micro-performance/FACS; stillness; gaze; blink timing; reaction shot; Murch; shot grammar; lens; visual storytelling

queries.query: Make a normal office hallway feel psychologically oppressive without changing it into a horror set. The architecture should remain believable and almost boring.
queries.hidden_target: neuroarchitecture; prospect/refuge; compression; scale/proportion; lighting; negative space; lens; production design; sound-space

queries.query: Create a 12-second chase shot where a character running at an ordinary human speed feels incredibly fast. No superpowers and no impossible camera movement.
queries.hidden_target: parallax; focal length/distance; screen direction; motion vectors; timing; gait; Laban; cutting rhythm; shutter/motion

queries.query: Two expert fighters duel. One is technically better, but the other is terrifying because his movement is unpredictable. Show me how their movement should look different before either one lands a hit.
queries.hidden_target: Laban Effort/Shape; movement signatures; direct/indirect; sudden/sustained; bound/free flow; footwork; gesture; personality-through-motion

queries.query: Design a scene where a woman walks into a room and everyone immediately understands she has more authority than everyone else, but she cannot speak, threaten anyone, or do anything obviously dominant.
queries.hidden_target: proxemics; kinesphere; posture; Bartenieff/Laban; pathways; staging; camera height; composition; visual weight; blocking

queries.query: I have a shot of a giant creature stepping onto a street, but it still feels like a person in a costume. Make the creature feel genuinely enormous without simply making it bigger in frame.
queries.hidden_target: scale cues; lens/perspective; parallax; atmospheric depth; compositing; contact shadows; dust/debris; secondary motion; timing; sound; VFX

queries.query: Create a product video for an ordinary black pen that makes it feel like something people urgently want, without saying it is premium, revolutionary, the best, or better than competitors.
queries.hidden_target: Ogilvy; Hopkins specificity; Breakthrough Advertising awareness/desire; StoryBrand; Made to Stick; visual persuasion

queries.query: A character has just received devastating news but is trying very hard not to react because other people are watching. Give me a cinematic video prompt where the emotion is obvious even though almost nothing happens.
queries.hidden_target: facial action leakage; suppression; FACS; blink/gaze; breathing; postural shifts; Laban/Bartenieff; acting for animation; Murch reaction timing; close-up; sound restraint

preserved_weaknesses.wc01_fake_smile: deep source (FACS/Ekman) NOMINATED by Scout, lost downstream at RERANK (WLK2)
preserved_weaknesses.wc07_silent_authority: WILDCARD underperforms FAST (FAST reaches Murch+Laban, WILDCARD drifts)
